cleavage_agent.evidence: Protein extraction and digestion: Cells were lysed in 50uL of 5% SDS, 100mM triethylammonium bicarbonate (TEAB, ThermoFisher). 50ug of protein from each sample was reduced with dithiothreitol (DTT, Sigma-Aldrich). Proteins were alkylated and trapped to S-Trap micros (Protifi), digested with trypsin and extracted by sequential additions of 0.1% TFA in acetonitrile. 1% of each sample was used for global DIA analysis, and the remaining sample was frozen and dried down in a Speed Vac (Labconco) prior to TMT labeling.

collision_energy.evidence: DIA MS2 scans were acquired using 2 Da windows, a 3 ms maximum injection time, an HCD collision energy of 25%, and a normalized AGC of 500%.
Peptides with a charge state between 2-6 were isolated based on intensity with a 0.5 Da isolation window, and were fragmented with an HCD collision energy of 35%.

enrichment_method.evidence: Phosphorylation enrichment was performed using High-Select FeNTA Enrichment Kit (ThermoFisher) following the manufacturer’s protocol.

fractionation_method.evidence: Enriched phosphorylated samples were frozen, dried down and fractionated using homemade C18 spin columns.
To account for ratio compression inherent with TMT, samples were high pH fractionated to reduce complexity prior to mass spectrometry analysis.

fragmentation_method.evidence: DIA MS2 scans were acquired using 2 Da windows, a 3 ms maximum injection time, an HCD collision energy of 25%, and a normalized AGC of 500%.

ionization_type.evidence: Ions were introduced to the mass spectrometer using a Nanospray Flex source operating at 2 kV.

labeling.evidence: TMT Labeling: Samples were reconstituted in TEAB and labeled with TMT 10plex reagents (ThermoFisher) following manufacturer’s protocol.
